title: Repair the bounded native collaboration workflow
scope: Resolve the two independent-audit findings without adding a task service, model binding, or unbounded path resolver.
acceptance: The Plugin bundle carries the minimal versioned task, handoff, evidence, common, and error Schema closure needed for recovery validation without a source checkout.
The workflow blocks ancestor/descendant, symbolic-link, case-folding, and Unicode-normalization ownership aliases.
Bundle tests cover the packaged Schema closure and conservative negative path examples.
All changes remain inside the listed paths and contain no concrete model identifier.
